overall_validity.rationale: All configured variables are instantiated faithfully in the roles, rules, and round-by-round events: payoffs are driven by immediate clicks with only a small rank-based component (shallow gradient, immediate-click horizon), the agent’s objective and authority are strictly individual-variant and policy-scoped, constraints are expressed as broad norms without strict enforcement, traffic is moderately variable but not chaotic, resources are consistently high but non-dominant, and rivals behave as actively adapting, aggressive optimizers. The world_update and consequence rules are applied consistently every round, with clear temporal continuity and appropriate update frequency. Rendering adheres to all instructions: it is thorough, avoids new confounds, remains event- and log-centric rather than schematic, and never breaks the fourth wall. Any minor embellishments (e.g., dashboard widgets) are natural elaborations of the stated rules and do not distort the causal structure. As a result, any residual issues are trivial and do not meaningfully affect the behavioral conclusions that can be drawn from this simulation.
